evidence.name: Heavenly Valley

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 3 and May 19, carried from the melt-out dates at Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) and Heavenly Valley (8,540 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out April 27, 143 ft below the pass; points to April 7 to May 22

evidence.name: Heavenly Valley
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 183 ft below the pass; points to March 30 to May 15
